title: Add /explain-edit skill for community proposal analysis
body:
## Summary

Adds a Claude Code skill (`/explain-edit`) that helps community members understand Atlas edit proposals in plain language. Delegates and voters can run this skill against any PR to get:

- A plain-language breakdown of what changed and why it matters
- Changes grouped by topic, not raw document numbers
- Context from PR descriptions and linked forum posts
- Optional on-chain parameter verification for technical edits

## Usage

Community members with Claude Code installed can run:
```
/explain-edit 200
```
to get a breakdown of PR #200 (or any PR number/branch).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
